scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n web,api,worker -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "cd apps/api && uv run celery -A app.worker.celery_app worker --loglevel=INFO"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/web build && cd apps/api && uv run python -m compileall -q app
scripts.check: pnpm --dir apps/web check && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy app && uv run pytest -q
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:deploy: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.format: pnpm --dir apps/web format && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
